missing.title.purpose: Title of the list of rekordbox tracks with no file.

missing.empty.where: Review screen, Missing list, when there are none.

missing.tracksCount_one.purpose: Track count beside a folder group (one).
missing.tracksCount_one.where: Review screen, Missing list, group heading with one track.

missing.tracksCount_other.purpose: Track count beside a folder group (several).
missing.tracksCount_other.where: Review screen, Missing list, group heading with several tracks.

missing.trackName.purpose: How a missing track with an artist is named.
missing.trackName.where: Review screen, Missing list, each track row ({{artist}} and {{title}} come from the track).

missing.unknownFolder.purpose: Names the group of missing tracks with no known folder.
missing.unknownFolder.where: Review screen, Missing list, group heading when rekordbox gave no folder.

missing.lastKnown.purpose: Tooltip explaining the path shown under a missing track.
missing.lastKnown.where: Review screen, Missing list, hover title of a track's last known path.

missing.addFolder.purpose: Button that adds a group's folder as a music folder.
missing.addFolder.where: Review screen, Missing list, on a group whose folder exists and isn't a music folder yet.

group.needsCloserLook.purpose: Heading of the queue group for decisions that take thought.
group.needsCloserLook.where: Review screen, queue on the left, group heading.

group.clearBestFile.purpose: Heading of the queue group where a Library track's linked file is gone and a copy is on disk.
group.clearBestFile.where: Review screen, queue on the left, group heading.

group.qualityProblems.purpose: Heading of the queue group for flagged files and better files for a linked file that is still there.
group.qualityProblems.where: Review screen, queue on the left, group heading.

queue.left_one.purpose: How many items a group still has, when one.
queue.left_one.where: Review screen, queue on the left, beside a group heading.

queue.left_other.purpose: How many items a group still has.
queue.left_other.where: Review screen, queue on the left, beside a group heading.

queue.empty.purpose: Says nothing is waiting for a decision.
queue.empty.where: Review screen, queue on the left, when all groups are empty.

queue.more.purpose: Loads the next page of a group's items.
queue.more.where: Review screen, queue on the left, under a group that has more items than are shown.

queue.acceptAll.purpose: Button that switches the "File missing, copy found" items that are clear cases to their suggested copy, in one step. {{count}} is how many it will switch: exactly the items the screen showed when it was pressed.
queue.acceptAll.where: Review screen, queue on the left, beside the "Clearly best file" heading, when at least one item can be switched this way.

item.moreTracks_one.purpose: Says one more track is in the item.
item.moreTracks_one.where: Review screen, queue on the left, an item with more tracks than are named.

item.moreTracks_other.purpose: Says how many more tracks are in the item.
item.moreTracks_other.where: Review screen, queue on the left, an item with more tracks than are named.

item.trackName.purpose: How a track with an artist is named. Same wording as missing.trackName.
item.trackName.where: Review screen, queue on the left, each item, and Review screen, comparison on the right, the track column.

item.untitled.purpose: Names a track that has no title and no file name.
item.untitled.where: Review screen, queue on the left, an item's track name.

kind.versionDoubt.purpose: What kind of item it is: two tracks the rules could not tell apart or keep apart.
kind.versionDoubt.where: Review screen, queue on the left, under each item of that kind.

kind.heldSet.purpose: What kind of item it is: duplicate files held because their pairs disagree.
kind.heldSet.where: Review screen, queue on the left, under each item of that kind.

kind.sameRecording.purpose: What kind of item it is: two Library tracks that are the same recording.
kind.sameRecording.where: Review screen, queue on the left, under each item of that kind.
kind.sameRecording.approved: Same track twice in your Library

kind.relink.purpose: What kind of item it is: a rekordbox entry matched to a file only probably.
kind.relink.where: Review screen, queue on the left, under each item of that kind.

kind.clearBestFile.purpose: What kind of item it is: the linked file is gone and a copy is on disk.
kind.clearBestFile.where: Review screen, queue on the left, under each item of that kind.

kind.qualityProblem.purpose: What kind of item it is: the linked file is flagged, cut off or broken.
kind.qualityProblem.where: Review screen, queue on the left, under each item of that kind.

kind.betterFile.purpose: What kind of item it is: a better copy exists beside a linked file that is still there.
kind.betterFile.where: Review screen, queue on the left, under each item of that kind.

compare.label.purpose: Accessible name of the table of an item's files.
compare.label.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, table (screen readers only).

compare.none.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, when nothing is selected.

compare.suggested.purpose: Names the file the app suggests; its reason follows.
compare.suggested.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, above the table ({{name}} is the file's name).

compare.doubt.purpose: Label of the reasons an item is in the queue.
compare.doubt.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, above the table, on items that have such reasons.

compare.moreFiles_one.purpose: Says one more file is not listed.
compare.moreFiles_one.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, under the table.

compare.moreFiles_other.purpose: Says how many more files are not listed.
compare.moreFiles_other.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, under the table.

compare.rekordboxEntry.purpose: Names the row that shows what rekordbox has for the track: its old location.
compare.rekordboxEntry.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, the track column of a relink item's second row.

compare.moreDetails.purpose: Switch that adds the bitrate, sample rate and date added columns to the comparison table.
compare.moreDetails.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, above the table.

action.label.purpose: Accessible name of the group of buttons for the selected item.
action.label.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, under the table (read by screen readers).

action.dismiss.purpose: Button that dismisses a "Better file available" item: the app stops suggesting that one file. It can be undone.
action.dismiss.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, under the table, for a "Better file available" item.

action.keepAnyway.purpose: Button that keeps a flagged file as it is: the track leaves "Quality problems". It can be undone.
action.keepAnyway.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, under the table, for a "Quality problem" item.

action.findBetter.purpose: Button that marks the track as wanted in better quality (for the wishlist, later) and takes the item out of the queue. It can be undone.
action.findBetter.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, under the table, for a "Quality problem" item.

action.switch.purpose: Button that links the Library track to the suggested copy, because its linked file is gone. It can be undone.
action.switch.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, under the table, for a "File missing, copy found" item.

action.confirm.purpose: Button that confirms a probable relink match: rekordbox's entry is this file. Its rekordbox data is then attached to the track. It can be undone.
action.confirm.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, under the table, for a "rekordbox match uncertain" item.

action.confirmAgain.purpose: Button that confirms a relink match the user confirmed before, whose file holds other audio now.
action.confirmAgain.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, under the table, for a "rekordbox match uncertain" item whose reason is "confirmed before, the audio has changed".

action.notSame.purpose: Button that says the file is not rekordbox's entry: the match is taken away and never made again. It can be undone.
action.notSame.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, under the table, for a "rekordbox match uncertain" item.

keys.enter.purpose: Names the key that does the item's suggested action; {{action}} is the label of that button.
keys.enter.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, in the row of buttons under the table.

keys.rows.purpose: Says what the number keys do when an item has more than one copy to switch to: the digit is the row of the table.
keys.rows.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, in the row of buttons under the table.

accepted.line_one.purpose: Says what Accept all did (one track).
accepted.line_one.where: Review screen, line at the top, after Accept all.

accepted.line_other.purpose: Says what Accept all did (several tracks).
accepted.line_other.where: Review screen, line at the top, after Accept all.

accepted.view.purpose: Button that shows each track Accept all switched, with its old and new file.
accepted.view.where: Review screen, line at the top, after Accept all.

accepted.hide.purpose: Button that closes the list of what Accept all switched.
accepted.hide.where: Review screen, line at the top, after Accept all, while the list is shown.

accepted.undo.purpose: Button that takes back Accept all, in one step.
accepted.undo.where: Review screen, line at the top, after Accept all.

accepted.dismiss.purpose: Button that removes the line about Accept all.
accepted.dismiss.where: Review screen, line at the top, after Accept all.

accepted.list.purpose: Names the list of tracks Accept all switched, for screen readers.
accepted.list.where: Review screen, line at the top, the list opened with View.

accepted.col.track.purpose: Column heading: a track Accept all switched.
accepted.col.track.where: Review screen, line at the top, the list opened with View.

accepted.col.from.purpose: Column heading: the file the track was linked to before.
accepted.col.from.where: Review screen, line at the top, the list opened with View.

accepted.col.to.purpose: Column heading: the file the track is linked to now.
accepted.col.to.where: Review screen, line at the top, the list opened with View.

switch.keepsEntry.purpose: Says what switching the linked file means in rekordbox when rekordbox's entry stays the track's (the app trusts the match of that entry to the copy).
switch.keepsEntry.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, above the Switch file button, for a track rekordbox knows whose entry is matched to the copy.

switch.newTrack.purpose: Warns what switching the linked file means in rekordbox when the copy goes there as a new track: the cues stay on the old entry, which the user then removes by hand; relocating in rekordbox is the way to keep them.
switch.newTrack.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, above the Switch file button, for a track rekordbox knows whose entry is not matched to the copy (or only probably).

switch.otherEntry.purpose: Warns what switching the linked file means in rekordbox when rekordbox holds a separate entry for the copy: the Library track is sent as that entry from then on, and the old entry is removed by hand.
switch.otherEntry.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, above the Switch file button, for a track rekordbox knows whose copy rekordbox holds as a separate track.

col.track.purpose: Column heading: which track the file is in.
col.track.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, table header, items with several tracks.

col.format.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, table header.

col.quality.purpose: Column heading: the file's quality verdict.
col.quality.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, table header.

col.length.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, table header.

col.tags.purpose: Column heading: how many descriptive tags are filled in.
col.tags.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, table header.

col.cover.purpose: Column heading: whether the file has embedded cover art.
col.cover.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, table header.

col.rekordbox.purpose: Column heading: whether rekordbox uses the file. rekordbox is written as it writes itself.
col.rekordbox.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, table header.

col.bitrate.purpose: Column heading: the file's bitrate. Shown with More details.
col.bitrate.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, table header.

col.sampleRate.purpose: Column heading: the file's sample rate. Shown with More details.
col.sampleRate.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, table header.

col.added.purpose: Column heading: the day the app first saw the file. Shown with More details.
col.added.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, table header.

mark.suggested.purpose: Marks the file the app suggests.
mark.suggested.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, the file column of the first row.

mark.linked.purpose: Marks the file the Library track plays.
mark.linked.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, the file column.

cell.yes.purpose: A yes in a table cell.
cell.yes.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, the cover and rekordbox columns.

cell.no.purpose: A no in a table cell.
cell.no.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, the cover and rekordbox columns.

cell.tags.purpose: How many of the descriptive tags a file has filled in.
cell.tags.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, the tags column.

cell.cutoff.purpose: The highest frequency measured in the file.
cell.cutoff.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, the quality column, under the verdict.

cell.bitrate.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, bitrate column.

cell.sampleRate.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, sample rate column.

verdict.notChecked.purpose: The file has no quality verdict yet.
verdict.notChecked.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, the quality column.

verdict.ok.purpose: The quality check found nothing wrong.
verdict.ok.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, the quality column.

verdict.lowBitrate.purpose: The quality check flagged a low bitrate.
verdict.lowBitrate.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, the quality column.

verdict.suspectTranscode.purpose: The quality check flagged audio made from a lower-quality file.
verdict.suspectTranscode.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, the quality column.

verdict.truncated.purpose: The quality check found the audio ends too early.
verdict.truncated.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, the quality column.

verdict.broken.purpose: The quality check found the file broken.
verdict.broken.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, the quality column.

reason.onlyFile.purpose: Reason: the track has one file.
reason.onlyFile.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, the reason under "Suggested" (a fragment, per docs/copy-style.md).

reason.notOnDisk.purpose: Reason: the suggested file is there and the other is gone.
reason.notOnDisk.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, the reason under "Suggested" (a fragment, per docs/copy-style.md).

reason.betterVerdict.purpose: Reason: the suggested file's quality verdict is better.
reason.betterVerdict.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, the reason under "Suggested" (a fragment, per docs/copy-style.md).

reason.playable.purpose: Reason: the suggested file's format plays in the DJ app and the other's does not.
reason.playable.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, the reason under "Suggested" (a fragment, per docs/copy-style.md).

reason.higherCutoff.purpose: Reason: both measured, the suggested file's cutoff is higher.
reason.higherCutoff.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, the reason under "Suggested" (a fragment, per docs/copy-style.md).

reason.higherCutoffMeasured.purpose: Reason: only the suggested file has a measured cutoff.
reason.higherCutoffMeasured.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, the reason under "Suggested" (a fragment, per docs/copy-style.md).

reason.fewerDecodeErrors.purpose: Reason: the suggested file has fewer decode errors.
reason.fewerDecodeErrors.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, the reason under "Suggested" (a fragment, per docs/copy-style.md).

reason.betterFormat.purpose: Reason: a better format; {{best}} and {{other}} are format names.
reason.betterFormat.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, the reason under "Suggested" (a fragment, per docs/copy-style.md).

reason.betterBitrate.purpose: Reason: the same format at a higher bitrate.
reason.betterBitrate.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, the reason under "Suggested" (a fragment, per docs/copy-style.md).

reason.moreTags.purpose: Reason: the suggested file has more tags filled in.
reason.moreTags.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, the reason under "Suggested" (a fragment, per docs/copy-style.md).

reason.hasArt.purpose: Reason: only the suggested file has cover art.
reason.hasArt.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, the reason under "Suggested" (a fragment, per docs/copy-style.md).

reason.knownToRekordbox.purpose: Reason: rekordbox knows the suggested file better.
reason.knownToRekordbox.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, the reason under "Suggested" (a fragment, per docs/copy-style.md).

reason.betterPlace.purpose: Reason: the suggested file is in a better place; {{best}} and {{other}} are where the suggested and the other file are (the place.* parts).
reason.betterPlace.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, the reason under "Suggested" (a fragment, per docs/copy-style.md).

reason.tied.purpose: Reason: nothing separates the files; the older one is suggested.
reason.tied.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, the reason under "Suggested" (a fragment, per docs/copy-style.md).

place.connected.purpose: Reason part: where the suggested file is, when the other one's drive is not connected.
place.connected.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, the reason under "Suggested" (a fragment, per docs/copy-style.md).

place.notConnected.purpose: Reason part: where the other file is, when its drive is not connected.
place.notConnected.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, the reason under "Suggested" (a fragment, per docs/copy-style.md).

place.scanFolder.purpose: Reason part: the file is in a music folder, not in the Inbox.
place.scanFolder.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, the reason under "Suggested" (a fragment, per docs/copy-style.md).

place.inboxFolder.purpose: Reason part: the file is in the Inbox folder.
place.inboxFolder.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, the reason under "Suggested" (a fragment, per docs/copy-style.md).

place.internalDrive.purpose: Reason part: the file is on a drive inside the computer.
place.internalDrive.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, the reason under "Suggested" (a fragment, per docs/copy-style.md).

place.externalDrive.purpose: Reason part: the file is on a drive that can be unplugged.
place.externalDrive.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, the reason under "Suggested" (a fragment, per docs/copy-style.md).

place.networkDrive.purpose: Reason part: the file is on a network share.
place.networkDrive.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, the reason under "Suggested" (a fragment, per docs/copy-style.md).

place.addedFirst.purpose: Reason part: the file is in the music folder that was added first.
place.addedFirst.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, the reason under "Suggested" (a fragment, per docs/copy-style.md).

place.addedLater.purpose: Reason part: the file is in a music folder that was added later.
place.addedLater.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, the reason under "Suggested" (a fragment, per docs/copy-style.md).

relink.filenameOnly.purpose: Reason for a relink: matched by file name alone.
relink.filenameOnly.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, the reason under "Suggested" (a fragment, per docs/copy-style.md).

relink.uniqueDuration.purpose: Reason for a relink: matched by its length among nearby files.
relink.uniqueDuration.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, the reason under "Suggested" (a fragment, per docs/copy-style.md).

relink.fingerprint.purpose: Reason for a relink: matched by the audio fingerprint.
relink.fingerprint.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, the reason under "Suggested" (a fragment, per docs/copy-style.md).

relink.filenameDuration.purpose: Reason for a relink: matched by file name and length.
relink.filenameDuration.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, the reason under "Suggested" (a fragment, per docs/copy-style.md).

relink.user.purpose: Reason for a relink: a confirmed match whose file now holds other audio.
relink.user.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, the reason under "Suggested" (a fragment, per docs/copy-style.md).

relink.other.purpose: Reason for a relink: any other rule.
relink.other.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, the reason under "Suggested" (a fragment, per docs/copy-style.md).

error.itemGone.purpose: Says an action did nothing because the item left the queue in the meantime (answered in another step, or the files changed).
error.itemGone.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, under the action buttons, after a refused action.

error.noAudioKnown.purpose: Says a decision can't be stored because the file it is about has not been hashed yet.
error.noAudioKnown.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, under the action buttons, after a refused action.

error.switchLinkedOnDisk.purpose: Says why the linked file is not switched: it is no longer gone.
error.switchLinkedOnDisk.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, under the Switch file button (greyed out), or after a refused switch.

error.switchNotInTrack.purpose: Says why the linked file is not switched: the copy is not one of the track's files any more.
error.switchNotInTrack.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, under the Switch file button (greyed out), or after a refused switch.

error.switchTargetGone.purpose: Says why the linked file is not switched: the copy is no longer on disk.
error.switchTargetGone.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, under the Switch file button (greyed out), or after a refused switch.

error.switchTargetLinked.purpose: Says why the linked file is not switched: the copy is the linked file of another Library track.
error.switchTargetLinked.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, under the Switch file button (greyed out), or after a refused switch.

error.switchEntryTaken.purpose: Says why the linked file is not switched: the rekordbox entry matched to the copy is the one another Library track is sent as, and that track would lose it.
error.switchEntryTaken.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, under the Switch file button (greyed out), or after a refused switch.

error.switchChanged.purpose: Says the switch was not made because what it means in rekordbox is no longer what the item showed; the item is shown again with the new text.
error.switchChanged.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, under the action buttons, after a refused switch.

action.keepBoth.purpose: Button that keeps both Library tracks of a "Same track twice" item: they stay two tracks and the pair is not asked about again. It can be undone.
action.keepBoth.where: Review screen, "Same track twice in your Library" item, action row under the table.

action.merge.purpose: Button that opens the choice of which track stays in a merge of two Library tracks that are the same recording; the one filled button. Nothing changes until the confirmation.
action.merge.where: Review screen, "Same track twice in your Library" item, action row under the table.

action.mergeConfirm.purpose: Confirmation button that merges: the other Library track leaves the Library (undoable). Restates the verb of the question.
action.mergeConfirm.where: Review screen, "Same track twice in your Library" item, the merge confirmation, filled button.

action.goBack.purpose: Second button of the merge confirmation: closes it, nothing changes.
action.goBack.where: Review screen, "Same track twice in your Library" item, the merge confirmation.

same.label.purpose: Accessible name of the small table of the item's Library tracks (cues, rating, plays, crates).
same.label.where: Review screen, "Same track twice in your Library" item, table under the file table.

same.col.cues.purpose: Column heading: how many cues rekordbox holds for the track (hot and memory cues).
same.col.cues.where: Review screen, "Same track twice in your Library" item, Library tracks table.

same.col.rating.purpose: Column heading: the track's rating in rekordbox.
same.col.rating.where: Review screen, "Same track twice in your Library" item, Library tracks table.

same.col.plays.purpose: Column heading: the track's play count in rekordbox.
same.col.plays.where: Review screen, "Same track twice in your Library" item, Library tracks table.

same.col.crates.purpose: Column heading: how many of the app's crates hold the track.
same.col.crates.where: Review screen, "Same track twice in your Library" item, Library tracks table.

same.notInRekordbox.purpose: Says rekordbox doesn't know the track, in place of its cues, rating and plays.
same.notInRekordbox.where: Review screen, "Same track twice in your Library" item, Library tracks table, cues column.

same.noRating.purpose: The track has no rating in rekordbox.
same.noRating.where: Review screen, "Same track twice in your Library" item, Library tracks table, rating column.

same.stars_one.where: Review screen, "Same track twice in your Library" item, Library tracks table, rating column.

same.stars_other.purpose: A rating of several stars ({{count}} is 2 to 5).
same.stars_other.where: Review screen, "Same track twice in your Library" item, Library tracks table, rating column.

same.choose.purpose: Question heading the choice of which Library track stays in a merge.
same.choose.where: Review screen, "Same track twice in your Library" item, the merge confirmation, above the list of tracks.

same.suggestedTrack.purpose: A track in the merge choice that the app suggests keeping ({{name}} is "Artist - Title").
same.suggestedTrack.where: Review screen, "Same track twice in your Library" item, the merge confirmation, one choice.

same.confirm_one.purpose: Warns what a merge of two Library tracks does: the track that leaves, its files and crates, what is lost in rekordbox, the remove list, and that it can be undone.
same.confirm_one.where: Review screen, "Same track twice in your Library" item, the merge confirmation, under the choice.

same.confirm_other.purpose: The same warning when several tracks leave ({{count}} is how many).
same.confirm_other.where: Review screen, "Same track twice in your Library" item, the merge confirmation, under the choice.

keep.moreCues.purpose: Reason: the suggested track to keep has more cues in rekordbox ({{count}}) than the next one ({{other}}).
keep.moreCues.where: Review screen, "Same track twice in your Library" item, the suggestion line.

keep.morePlays.purpose: Reason: the suggested track to keep was played more in rekordbox ({{count}} against {{other}}).
keep.morePlays.where: Review screen, "Same track twice in your Library" item, the suggestion line.

keep.tied.purpose: Reason: nothing separates the tracks; the older one is suggested.
keep.tied.where: Review screen, "Same track twice in your Library" item, the suggestion line.

error.mergeLinkedVersions.purpose: Refusal: two tracks of the item are linked as versions, and versions are never merged.
error.mergeLinkedVersions.where: Review screen, "Same track twice in your Library" item, under the action row after Merge.
